title: Father's Legacy
next_chapter_hook: The moment the Turtle Shell artifact resonated with the Tianji Record, an unprecedented wave of power swept through—a dimensional breath from beyond the heavens, the final gift Father left for Chen Ji.

text.content: Two wills clashed within his body, and Chen Ji felt his Mental Sea being torn apart. On one side was Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul—aged and steady; on the other was something far more ancient and violent. Yet at that moment, the Turtle Shell on his chest, which had never reacted before, suddenly burned hot, as if a giant beast that had slumbered for ten thousand years had finally opened its eyes.

The surface of the Turtle Shell revealed densely packed patterns. Chen Ji had observed those patterns countless times, dismissing them as traces of time. But now, as his blood dripped onto the Turtle Shell, the patterns writhed like living creatures, transforming into a obscure yet strangely familiar scripture—written in his father's hand.

dialogue.content: This... is impossible! These are characters from beyond the dimensional rift! Boy, who exactly is your father?

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer. His consciousness was pulled into a strange space. There was no heaven, no earth—only a void of gray whiteness. Yet within that grayness, a vague figure stood with its back to him. The figure wore the rough cloth garments Chen Ji knew so well, shoulders slightly stooped, yet standing as upright as a pine.

dialogue.content: (Father's figure slowly turned around, revealing a weathered yet gentle face, with deep shadows hidden in the corner of his eyes that Chen Ji had never seen before) Ji'er, you've finally come.

text.content: Chen Ji wanted to speak, but found his voice bound by some unknown force. He could only watch as his father's figure grew clearer, and within that gaze, beneath the affection, lay a guilt Chen Ji had never detected.

dialogue.content: This Turtle Shell is no ordinary object. It comes from the dimension above the heavens—the Formless Realm. I traded my entire lifespan for this hope. I intended to deliver it to you personally, but never imagined...

text.content: Father's remnant shadow stretched out his hand, wanting to touch Chen Ji's cheek, but passed through the void. The space began to shake, and Chen Ji's consciousness was forcibly pulled back to reality. But in that instant, he felt the last wisp of will his father had left within the Turtle Shell—a complete and massive plan.

So Father's layout was a hundred times more profound than Chen Ji could have imagined. He had already calculated that the Tianji Record would end up in Chen Ji's hands, and that when the Tianji Record was complete, it would surely provoke heavenly backlash. Therefore, he used himself as bait, stepping into the Formless Realm in exchange for this Turtle Shell—which could, at a critical moment, shield one from the heavens' scrutiny.

dialogue.content: So that's it... Old one finally understands. Your father was no ordinary cultivator—he was the previous holder of the Tianji Record!

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice trembled. Chen Ji had never heard this mysterious being so discomposed. The patterns on the Turtle Shell grew brighter, producing an unprecedented resonance with the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. A warm force surged from his chest, dispelling the coldness within and simultaneously calming the two wills battling for dominance.

choice.prompt: Father's遗志 clearly presented before him, Chen Ji needed to make a choice:

choices.description: Accept Father's complete layout, become the true Chess Player of this game, and transform Father's sacrifice into power.
choices.visible_reward: The Turtle Shell artifact fully awakens, gaining dimensional perception abilities
choices.risk_hint: Inheriting the will means bearing greater responsibility

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, letting that warm force flood into his Mental Sea. He felt his father's breath, his father's joys and sorrows, his father's resolve. A supreme expert hidden beneath the guise of an ordinary farmer, who spent a lifetime paving the way for his son. Tears fell silently, yet Chen Ji smiled.

choices.memory_label: 接受了父亲的全部传承

choices.description: Why did Father bear everything alone? Why didn't he tell him the truth? Was this sacrifice truly necessary?
choices.visible_cost: May shake the resolve to inherit
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete information about Father's layout
choices.risk_hint: The truth may be heavier than imagined

text.content: "Father... why did you hide this from me?" Chen Ji's voice was hoarse, carrying years of suppressed grievance. Father's figure paused slightly, and a complex light flickered in his eyes.

choices.memory_label: 追问了父亲隐瞒的原因

choices.description: Not merely inherit, but walk a path farther than Father's—overturn the entire chessboard, including the rules Father set.
choices.visible_cost: The Turtle Shell may produce a rejection reaction
choices.visible_reward: Unlock the Turtle Shell's hidden dimensional leap ability
choices.process_label: reject set path create new possibilities

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, a brilliance utterly different from his father's flickering within. "Father, I will take over your chess game—but the rules, I will set." The Turtle Shell trembled, emitting a low rumble, as if responding to this audacious yet firm declaration.

choices.memory_label: 决意超越父亲改写规则

text.content: Just then, a line of text never seen before appeared on the Turtle Shell's surface—written in Formless Realm script: "Only when my son surpasses this realm may he reunite with his father." Chen Ji stared at those words, an indescribable emotion surging in his chest—so Father had always believed he could do it.

dialogue.content: Good lad... Your father indeed did not misjudge. The Formless Realm is a dimension even Da Luo Golden Immortals cannot reach. To obtain this Turtle Shell, your father was willing to endure dimensional tearing as a mortal body—every day he lived was a battle between his life and the heavens of the Formless Realm.

text.content: Chen Ji's hand tightly gripped the Turtle Shell, a piercing pain radiating through his palm. Faint cracks appeared on the Turtle Shell's surface, yet healed at a visible rate—Father's life force infused within was resonating with Chen Ji.

Chen Ji suddenly understood. Why had Father lived so long as a mortal—not to prolong his dying days, but to wait. Wait for him to grow strong enough, wait for him to bear the weight of this Turtle Shell. Tears blurred his vision again, yet Chen Ji laughed aloud.

choice.prompt: The Turtle Shell artifact fully awakened, and Chen Ji's body was undergoing transformation. Now he needed to decide how to use this power:

choices.description: The Turtle Shell's power can conceal the Tianji Record's aura, used to protect those around him, creating an absolutely safe rear.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes a large amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Unlock the "Heavenly Protection" skill, which can absorb fatal damage for others at critical moments
choices.risk_hint: Overuse may deepen the Turtle Shell's cracks
choices.process_label: use father's relic protect loved ones

text.content: The Turtle Shell emanated a faint halo, enveloping Chen Ji within. That halo carried Father特有的 warmth, like an invisible hand gently patting his shoulder. Chen Ji took a deep breath, storing the Turtle Shell in his Mental Sea, alongside the Tianji Record.

choices.description: Using the Turtle Shell's dimensional perception, foresee enemy movements in advance, seize the initiative of fate's axis.
choices.visible_reward: Unlock the "Dimensional Perception" skill, capable of seeing through all layouts within the Three Realms
choices.risk_hint: Powerful perception will attract attention from higher dimensions

text.content: A sharp light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. The Turtle Shell's power instantly merged with the Tianji Record. His perceptual range expanded geometrically—every hidden guard within the Tianqing Sect, every stronghold of the Holy Sect, even the tendrils of the Heavenly Eye, all clearly appeared in his mind.

The moment power awakened, Chen Ji's consciousness was pulled into a chaotic void. Countless images flickered like a passing show—he saw his father's youthful vigor, saw his father's shock upon discovering the Tianji Record, and most importantly, saw his father stepping into the Formless Realm without hesitation to protect him, still in swaddling clothes.

dialogue.content: (Father's voice echoed in the void, like words spanning countless ages) Ji'er, the Tianji Record is a piece placed by the heavens. But the Turtle Shell is different—it comes from beyond the dimensions, the only thing capable of breaking the chessboard. I left it for you, not to ask you to avenge me, but for you to... walk your own path.

text.content: Chen Ji's consciousness violently returned to reality. He found himself kneeling on the ground, tears streaming down his face, the Turtle Shell quietly resting in his palm, its warm luster slowly fading. Father's face gradually blurred in his mind, yet that heavy expectation remained crystal clear.

choice.prompt: Father's presence had dissipated, but his will forever remained within the Turtle Shell. Faced with this heavy love, Chen Ji needed to make his final response:

choices.description: Make a vow to the Turtle Shell: I will not fail your trust, and one day I will set foot in the Formless Realm to reunite with Father.
choices.visible_reward: The Turtle Shell and Tianji Record produce a deeper resonance, unlocking the hidden skill "Father and Son as One"
choices.risk_hint: Once a vow is made, it cannot be broken

text.content: Chen Ji pressed the Turtle Shell to his forehead, murmuring softly: "Father, your son has been unfilial, making you wait so long. But from now on, only one person speaks on this chessboard—me, Chen Ji." The Turtle Shell trembled slightly, as if responding to this vow.

choices.memory_label: 对父亲许下超越维度的誓言

choices.description: No words needed—Chen Ji already fully understood Father's love. Silently store the Turtle Shell in his Mental Sea, letting actions replace vows.
choices.visible_cost: The Turtle Shell may not fully awaken
choices.visible_reward: Gain a remnant of Father's combat experience
choices.risk_hint: Silence may be interpreted as hesitation

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak. He slowly rose, tucking the Turtle Shell close to his body. Some emotions need no words. In his heart, he silently memorized Father's appearance, memorizing that love never spoken aloud. From now on, he would live not just for himself, but for Father.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted out, rarely showing a gentle expression: "Your father was the smartest person this old one has ever met—he knew the Tianji Record would draw heavenly backlash, yet still bet everything on you." He paused, "Now it seems, he won the bet." Chen Ji wiped the tears from the corner of his eye, a familiar arc curling at his lips—the composure unique to one who pretends to be weak before devouring the tiger. "Won the bet?" he said softly, "No, he simply left nothing to chance." The Turtle Shell glowed faintly in his Mental Sea, as if responding to its master's words.
